name: Matrices & determinants
description: The matrix environments, with (), [] and || delimiters, dots, and an augmented matrix.
notes: Augmented matrix: an `array` with `|` in the column spec, wrapped in `\left[ ... \right]`.
Inline in text: `$\left(\begin{smallmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{smallmatrix}\right)$`.
